item.title: WordPress SEO & Lead Automation Specialist
item.description:
15-20 AUD/hr | Freelance Website, SEO and Lead Generation Support
Assurance HR Management | Ongoing freelance work | 10–15 hours per week | Up to AUD $20 per hour
Assurance HR Management (AHR) is an Australian consultancy providing HR, industrial relations, workplace health and safety, workers compensation, investigations, recruitment and training services. We’re looking for a freelancer who can maintain our WordPress website, improve organic search visibility, and help turn website visits into enquiries that our team can follow up.
Visit the AHR website⁠￼
What you’ll do
* Review the website each week. Check priority pages for broken links, outdated information, spelling and formatting errors, and problems with navigation, enquiry forms and booking links. Review key pages on desktop and mobile. * Make approved WordPress updates. Fix website errors, update approved copy and images, and publish approved service pages and articles. Verify changes on the live site and flag issues that need a developer or an AHR specialist. * Improve organic SEO. Use Yoast SEO or a similar tool to improve page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and image alt text. Use Google Search Console and, where available, Google Analytics to identify issues and recommend improvements to priority pages. * Build and improve lead-generating landing pages. Create pages with a clear offer, a strong call to action and a simple enquiry or booking process. Track where enquiries come from and use the results to improve the pages and forms. * Set up contact automation and CRM pipelines. Connect website forms and booking tools to the CRM and email platform. Configure lead source tracking, assignment, internal notifications, acknowledgement emails and follow-up steps. Set up pipeline stages so the team can see who owns each enquiry and what needs to happen next. Test the full journey from submission to follow-up. * Send a short weekly update. Summarise what you checked, fixed or improved, what needs attention next, and the hours worked.
What we’re looking for
You’ll need hands-on experience with WordPress, organic SEO, lead-generating landing pages, contact automation and CRM pipelines. You should be comfortable both building the landing page and configuring what happens after someone submits the form.
Experience with Capsule CRM, Mailchimp, Gravity Forms or Calendly is useful. Experience with equivalent tools is welcome. Strong written English, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise work within an agreed weekly budget are essential. Website edits should use Australian English.
Hours and how to apply
We expect 10–15 hours per week, depending on priorities, at up to AUD $20 per hour. We’ll provide the detailed handover, priority work and account access once the freelancer is selected.
Please include your hourly rate in AUD, weekly availability and two relevant examples. At least one should show a landing page you built or improved and explain what happened after a visitor submitted an enquiry. Tell us what you personally set up, which tools you used and how you verified it worked.

item.title: WordPress Search Page — Phase 1 Build, Phase 2 Python API Integration

item.title: E-Commerce Order Chatbot Build

item.title: Build Searchable Journal Archive Platform
item.description:
3000-5000 USD | Functionality to Parse and Display Journals on Our Website
My stamp club produces a quarterly journal. The Journal is posted on our website with both the ability to browse the complete journal and search the journal. The journal search is more than just a key word search, it pulls up the complete articles with the key word being searched irrespective of the page. For example, if the article is on page 2-4 and then continues to page 10 and 11, the search will display the complete article. Similar to how a story may be organized in a Newspaper. The current functionality relies upon the individual who runs the program breaking down the content, which has not been reliable.
The club is looking to develop functionality that replaces and enhances this functionality and is owned by the club so we can use this functionality on other journals. The current functionality can be found on: https://www.collectorsclub.org/ccp/browse-search-the-ccp/ Test copies of the journal (CCP) can be obtained by using the browse selection.
Requirements: • The product must work with our current WordPress website – Please address the ease at which your proposal can be used should the club migrate away from WordPress. (You will see the current functionality is NOT integrated with WordPress. • The Club plans to transition to a commercially available Membership Plug in such as Ultimate Membership Pro or similar. If your proposal is contingent upon a specific membership Plug in please list this. We can consider a variety of membership plug-ins, beyond the standard functionality we require the ability to pro-rate a subscription. https://ultimatemembershippro.com/
- Search Functionality - • Perform Keyword search that are included in the larger website search as well as the journal only. o User can choose different categories of assets (Similar to the way WordPress allows users to Create Categories and Sub-Categories and those categories can be incorporated into a search or display.  Example of how to expand internal CCP Components:  Currently we can search by Author, Advertiser, year(s) with groupings, as well as keyword  We may want to add other categories as some point, like “Presidents Message” or “Financial Report” ect. We understand that adding the categories will require work by the club to identify the sections in journals that have been processed.  Examples of Categories outside the CCP Journals could be: Website content, Specific other Journals from other Clubs (ie. Search a journal called BNA and the CCP). We do not have these External categories yet, but would like a tool that will allow us to other sources. • We have a vast Video Library which we plan to develop transcripts. The Search should have the ability to link the Transcript to the video such that the video and transcript will appear in the search. • The ability for a user to save their research to use at a future time. • A push capability that will message a user when content is added that meets their search criteria. • The ability of researchers to leave comments about the article. o The comments must go to a Web Admin for approval before Posting (typical WordPress functionality). • Ability to identify the award willing Articles (Can be part of the Search). • The ability of the User to Click on an author’s name and be connected to an Author Profile Page – as if the Authors were users. • The ability to display content based on Membership Category (normal wordpress functionality).
- Requirements for the functionality to Parse the Journals and storage- • We understand that this will likely require a volunteer to identify the Journal Sections. The more this can be automated the better. o We need the ability to add categories. • Should be simple and easy to use by non-technical volunteers or the Journal editor. • Scalable to accommodate a future volume for the club or assets not stored on the Club server.
We are not adverse to a solution that adapts an existing product, such as WooCommerce to meet our needs. Please include the required licenses for your solution: ie. Adobe Acrobat Pro: etc. Please include information that addresses how the solution can be updated with changes in Wordpress or the assumed technology. The Club will own the solution developed and have the right to sub-license. You are welcome to share solutions that expand upon the functionality we would like, but please specify if there are any areas that will be problematic or will constitute a disproportionate cost such that the club can assess if that feature warrants our investment at this time. Thank you.

item.title: Service Booking Website & Admin Dashboard
item.description: 2-8 USD/hr | I run a small team that handles cleaning, moving, furniture assembly, delivery, and gardening jobs. I need a modern, mobile-friendly website that makes it effortless for visitors to land on the homepage, understand what we do at a glance, and book the help they need. Core user flow • Visitors arrive on a polished landing page, pick a service, complete a simple booking form, choose a date and time, upload any helpful photos, and pay online and an option to pay cash. • They can just as easily request a quote when details are unclear. • Once the booking is placed, customers create (or log in to) an account where they can track job status in real time and review past orders. Back-office requirements On my side I want a clean dashboard—accessible from any device—to view, edit, and assign incoming jobs, update progress, issue invoices or refunds, and export basic reports. Staff logins with role-based permissions are essential so the team only sees what they need. Key expectations – Sleek, fast UI that feels current rather than templated. – Secure payment integration (Stripe or similar). – Responsive design and clear calls to action. – SEO-ready structure and Google Analytics connected. – Training or concise documentation so my team can add services, prices, and promotions without developer help. Tech stack is open; WordPress with custom plugins, Laravel + Vue, or a React/Node build are all fine as long as performance, security, and future scalability are covered. Deliverables 1. Live website hosted on our domain, HTTPS enabled. 2. Admin dashboard with role controls and job management. 3. Payment gateway fully tested in production mode. 4. One-page guide (or short screen-share session) explaining routine updates. If you have previous examples of service-booking portals or dashboards you built, share the links so I can gauge fit. Let’s create a site that impresses at first click and keeps operations tidy behind the scenes.

item.title: Counselling Website Development
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Squarespace Website SEO Optimisation and Improvements for Counselling Practice
I'm looking for an experienced Squarespace web developer or SEO specialist to help improve the visibility and performance of my existing counselling practice website.
I already have a fully functioning website for my private counselling practice, Clear Current Counselling, and I'm not looking for a complete redesign or a new website.
My main aim is to improve local search visibility, attract potential clients and make it easier for people to find out about my services and get in touch.
Existing website: https://www.clearcurrentcounselling.co.uk/
Areas I'd like support with
Local SEO: Improve visibility for relevant searches such as counsellor in Ramsgate, counselling in Thanet and counselling in East Kent.
On-page SEO: Review and optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image descriptions and relevant keywords.
Website content: Identify opportunities to improve the wording and structure of existing pages so that search engines and potential clients can understand my services.
Google visibility: Check Google indexing, Google Search Console and any technical issues affecting search performance.
AI search visibility: Explore ways to improve how my practice is represented in AI-powered search tools such as ChatGPT and Google AI.
User experience: Review the website's mobile layout, navigation and contact links to make it easier for potential clients to enquire.
Enquiry journey: Ensure that contact details, introductory consultation information and calls to action are clear and accessible.
About my business
Clear Current Counselling is an independent counselling practice based in Ramsgate, Kent. I offer integrative, person-centred and trauma-informed counselling for adults and young people aged 11 and over.
I offer face-to-face sessions in Ramsgate, subject to room availability, as well as online counselling across the UK.
I am an NCPS Accredited Member and Registered Member of BACP.
What I'm looking for
I'd particularly like someone with:
Proven experience working with Squarespace websites.
Experience in local SEO and improving search visibility for small businesses.
An understanding of service-based businesses, ideally within counselling, therapy, healthcare or wellbeing.
The ability to make practical improvements directly to an existing website rather than simply providing an audit.
An understanding of website user experience and how to encourage enquiries.
Budget and scope
My current budget is approximately £100 for a one-off project.
I'm therefore looking for someone who can recommend and implement the most valuable improvements within this budget. I'm open to a fixed-price package or a small number of hours of focused work.
Please include examples of similar websites or businesses you've worked with, your relevant experience, and what you would realistically be able to achieve within my budget.
I'm not looking for guaranteed Google rankings or ongoing monthly SEO packages. I'm looking for practical, worthwhile improvements that will help my existing website reach more potential clients.

item.title: Website for Local Pet Shop
item.description:
30-250 USD | I'm looking for a web developer to create a modern, well-designed website for a small independent pet shop based in the UK. We're a local business selling pet food, treats, toys, grooming products and accessories, mainly for dogs and cats.
At the moment, we don't have a proper website, and I'd like to change that. I'm not looking for a large online store or anything particularly complicated. I just want a professional website that represents the shop properly, looks trustworthy and makes it easier for local customers to find us and see what we offer.
**What I have in mind**
The homepage should give visitors a good first impression of the business. I'd like a nice header with the shop's name, a simple navigation menu and a main section with a relevant pet-related image and a short introduction. Below that, there could be a few sections highlighting our main product categories, a short description of the shop and a clear way to find our contact details.
For the products section, I'd like customers to be able to browse the types of products we sell. We mainly focus on dog food, cat food, treats, toys, collars, leads, beds and basic grooming supplies. These don't need individual product pages or prices for now. A simple layout with images, category names and short descriptions would be enough.
I'd prefer the products to be arranged in a way that doesn't make the website feel cluttered. For example, customers could select a category and see a few relevant products underneath. I don't mind whether this is done using separate pages or a simple filtering system, as long as it's easy to use.
I'd also like an About Us section. Nothing too long, just some information about the business and the fact that we're an independent local pet shop. I think this would help make the website feel a little more personal rather than looking like a generic online shop.
The contact page is quite important. It should display our address, telephone number and opening hours clearly. I'd also like a Google Maps link or an embedded map so customers can easily find the shop. A simple contact form would be useful too, allowing people to send us a message with their name, email address and enquiry.
**Design and appearance**
I don't have an exact design prepared, so I'm open to suggestions from the developer. However, I do have a general idea of how I'd like it to look.
I'd prefer a fairly modern and clean design, with natural colours such as green, beige, white or other colours that suit a pet-related business. Nothing too bright or childish. The website should feel friendly and welcoming, but still professional.
I'd also like some good-quality images of dogs, cats and pet products throughout the website. These don't need to be custom photographs, and suitable royalty-free images would be perfectly fine.
The layout should have enough space between sections, readable text and consistent styling across all pages. I don't want excessive animations, pop-ups or anything that makes the website unnecessarily complicated.
It's particularly important that the website works properly on mobile phones. I expect quite a few customers will be visiting from their phones, so the navigation, images and text should adapt to smaller screens without issues.
**Technical requirements**
I'm not particularly concerned about which technology is used. HTML, CSS and JavaScript would be fine, but I'm open to other suggestions if there's a good reason to use them.
The website should load reasonably quickly, have working navigation and include basic SEO elements such as page titles, descriptions and appropriate headings.
I don't need user accounts, online payments, shopping carts, inventory management or any advanced backend functionality.
For the contact form, I'd like to discuss a simple way of handling messages. I'm open to a basic email form service if that makes more sense than building a backend.
I'd also appreciate it if the code was reasonably organised, so making changes later wouldn't be too difficult.
**What I expect to receive**
Once the website is finished, I'd like to receive all the source files, including the HTML, CSS, JavaScript and any other files used in the project.
I'd also like a short explanation of how to run the website locally and how to change basic information such as opening hours, phone numbers, text and images.
Hosting and domain registration are not required at this stage. I may arrange those separately once I'm happy with the finished website.
Before considering the project complete, I'd like to see the website working on both desktop and mobile, check that all links work and make sure the contact form behaves as expected.
